title: Bills 163 and 164 for 163-acre Central Maui growth
summary: Bill 163 CD1 would add a 163.443-acre portion of a parcel to the Maui Island Plan's urban growth boundary, and Bill 164 CD1 would change it from Agriculture to Business Multifamily; testifiers raised a single untested well, closeness to the runway and an unfinished final EIS. The Council later passed Bills 163 and 164 nine to zero.

timeline.text: Bills 163 and 164 passed nine to zero.
Group of bills on second and final reading: Bills 140, 141, 145, 147, 153, 161, 163, 164, 165, 168 and 169 passed second and final reading together.
